data.markdown:
# Traffic Drop in Grand Tunis Due to Planned Transport Maintenance

- **Classification:** planned_maintenance
- **Root cause:** planned_maintenance at `LNK-TUN-01-A`
- **Confidence:** high (Directly evidenced by matching maintenance window MW-0003 and simultaneous SITE_DOWN alarms on all affected sites. External events were NOT CHECKED via tool calls, but internal transport logs and maintenance schedules fully account for the incident.)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-07 01:30 to 2026-09-07 04:30
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-07 01:35
- **Affected:** S-TUN-002, S-TUN-003, S-TUN-005, LNK-TUN-01-A

## Summary

Routine transport network works performed on shared fiber link LNK-TUN-01-A.

Availability and traffic dropped to zero on S-TUN-002, S-TUN-003, and S-TUN-005 due to planned transport maintenance on their shared link.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-07 01:30: Anomaly alert ALR-0005 triggered for availability, active users, and download volume drops on S-TUN-002, S-TUN-003, and S-TUN-005. [ALR-0005, ANM-000066, ANM-000070, ANM-000073]
- 2026-09-07 01:35: Planned maintenance window MW-0003 started on transport link LNK-TUN-01-A. [MW-0003]
- 2026-09-07 01:39: Critical SITE_DOWN alarms raised on S-TUN-003 (ALM-000141), S-TUN-002 (ALM-000142), and S-TUN-005 (ALM-000143). [ALM-000141, ALM-000142, ALM-000143]
- 2026-09-07 04:22: SITE_DOWN alarm cleared on S-TUN-005 (ALM-000143). [ALM-000143]
- 2026-09-07 04:23: SITE_DOWN alarms cleared on S-TUN-003 (ALM-000141) and S-TUN-002 (ALM-000142). [ALM-000141, ALM-000142]
- 2026-09-07 04:28: Planned maintenance window MW-0003 completed on transport link LNK-TUN-01-A. [MW-0003]

## Evidence

- Sites S-TUN-002, S-TUN-003, and S-TUN-005 experienced drops in availability, active users, and volume starting at 2026-09-07 01:30. [ALR-0005, ANM-000066, ANM-000070, ANM-000073]
- All three affected sites share the exact same transport fiber link LNK-TUN-01-A. [T4, S-TUN-002, LNK-TUN-01-A]
- Planned maintenance window MW-0003 was executed on LNK-TUN-01-A from 2026-09-07 01:35 to 2026-09-07 04:28. [MW-0003, T3]
- Critical SITE_DOWN alarms were active across all three sites during the exact timeframe of the maintenance window. [T2, ALM-000141, ALM-000142, ALM-000143]

## Hypotheses

1. **planned_maintenance** at LNK-TUN-01-A: confirmed. Maintenance window MW-0003 on shared link LNK-TUN-01-A directly matches the timing and scope of SITE_DOWN alarms and traffic drops on S-TUN-002, S-TUN-003, and S-TUN-005. [MW-0003, ALM-000141, ALM-000142, ALM-000143, T3]
2. **transport_failure** at LNK-TUN-01-A: rejected. Although the symptoms resemble an unplanned fiber cut, the event is fully accounted for by the documented planned maintenance schedule MW-0003. [MW-0003, RB-FIBER-CUT#03]
3. **bad_change**: rejected. Tool T5 reported no changes on S-TUN-002, S-TUN-003, S-TUN-005 and their parents between 2026-09-06 18:00 and 2026-09-07 06:00. [T5]

## Ruled out

- ALR-0004: Involved different sites (S-TUN-011 and S-TUN-013) earlier in the evening (starting 2026-09-06 19:15) and is unrelated to the midnight outage on S-TUN-002, S-TUN-003, and S-TUN-005.
- T5: No configuration changes were applied to the affected sites or their ancestors during the incident window, ruling out a bad change.

## Recommended actions

- Ensure advance notifications for planned transport maintenance are properly communicated to operations to correlate expected service interruptions.
